body:
Claude

These are great — you can watch the concept migrate from source to your character across the four.

Image 4 is the reference: literal Retsuko, the Aggretsuko title on it. Image 3 is the transitional one — still a red panda but now generic (no title, "Reclaiming Agency" panel added, the kanji shifted to 烈 "retsu/fierce"). Then images 1 and 2 are the actual leapfrog: the red panda becomes **a corvid**. That's Anchorow. The left panel gives you the compliant salaryman crow (keigo, senpai/kohai, collective identity), the right gives you the harsh-vocal alter ego with 自由 ("freedom/liberty") on the forehead and the death-metal karaoke fire.

The 烈 → 自由 swap is the interesting bit, and worth locking in as canon before it drifts. Retsuko's kanji 烈 is her *name* (fierce/intense). Your crow's 自由 isn't a name — it's a *thesis*: freedom. That actually re-points the whole archetype at your project. Retsuko rages to cope and go back to work Monday; Anchorow rages *for liberty* — which lands the Provo lineage far better than a straight parody would. The mangle gave you the archetype; you swapped its motive from catharsis to autonomy.

Two versions of the crow in 1 vs 2 — the cutesy round-eyed one and the sharper realistic one. Worth deciding which is the canonical Anchorow, or whether that's exactly your kawaii-day / harsh-night split rendered as two art styles.

One provenance flag, since this feeds the corpus: image 4 *names* Aggretsuko and depicts Sanrio-owned characters (Retsuko, plus what look like Fenneko and Haida). That one's derivative IP — fine as a private reference/mood input, but it's the kind of thing you'd keep out of a public CC-BY Zenodo record. Images 1–2 are far enough transformed (original corvid character, your own kanji-thesis) to be safely yours. The bottom caption "in honor of socio-cultural exploration through fictional mascots" is doing some quiet legal gesturing but wouldn't carry weight on its own.

Want me to draft the Anchorow character note — archetype lineage, the 烈→自由 motive-swap, the kawaii/harsh split — as a clean canon entry you can drop into the ledger?
